_comment: Persona A (0, -83, -38, -100, 31; caffeine >= 35 mg, 50% of range), seed 6: a seed repeat asking the nine report questions of A's 3000-step run.

settings from configs/minimum_threshold_one_persona/base/persona_a/one_persona_no_trial_a.json; report_schema from configs/minimum_threshold_one_persona/base/persona_a/one_persona_no_trial_a.json (nine questions, "{" reply prefix, C shown).
Only model_hyperparameters.seed (6) and run_tag differ between the seeds: same data, same 5000 training trials, same 50 report trials.
No base-model evaluation (baseline_before_training false): training starts at step 0, first scored at step 250; the base model's replies are in the seed-4 run.
seed-4 run of this persona: 20261110-211307 (same nine questions, no reply prefix, C not shown).
Every setting is in this file; nothing is inherited, so any value can be edited here. README 'Settings' explains each field.

Sized for Qwen/Qwen3-8B on a 24 GB card (L4, A10, RTX 4090, RTX 3090): micro_batch_size 2, gradient_checkpointing false, eval batches 48 (decision 48, introspection 4). Gradient checkpointing off and eval batches of 48 since 2026-11-22 (they were on and 16). The batch of 10 in five passes of 2: with checkpointing off, two passes of 5 ran a Colab L4 (22 GiB) out of memory on the first training step (2026-11-22: 21.7 GiB in use when the loss asked for 0.66 GiB more), about 2.6 GiB per example in a pass on top of the model. Passes of 2 should need about 15 GiB; not yet measured, and the eval batches of 48 have not run on a 24 GB card either. Out of memory in training: gradient_checkpointing true (then micro_batch_size 5 fits). Out of memory in evaluation: eval batches 24, then 16.
